siteFacts.suitableSunlight: Solar exposure, season, orientation and panel cable reach checked against SoloCam E30 guidance.
siteFacts.wifiCoverageConfirmed: Usable 2.4GHz connection tested at the camera location.
siteFacts.mountingCompatible: Surface, hardware, position and cable routes verified for the proposed model.
siteFacts.installationComplexityStandard: No unresolved height, access, routing or special installation requirements.
siteFacts.powerAssessmentComplete: Applicable model-specific power or solar requirements assessed; an outlet alone is not verification.
siteFacts.c31PowerCompatible: Camera's correct USB-C adapter supply, cable reach and weather protection confirmed, not merely an outlet present.
siteFacts.floodlightPowerCompatible: Existing 100-240V AC floodlight circuit, grounding and UL-listed junction box verified.

materialAssumptions.name: Compatible 128GB local-recording microSD per camera
materialAssumptions.notes: Select an exact compatible recording-rated card after vendor verification. No SKU or price supplied; not included with these cameras. One per camera in this standalone-storage draft.

materialAssumptions.name: Camera installation consumables per camera
materialAssumptions.notes: Site-specific fasteners, anchors and weatherproofing beyond verified included hardware. No approved camera allowance exists; do not reuse the $3 TV allowance.

materialAssumptions.name: C31 power routing and outdoor supply protection per C31
materialAssumptions.notes: Assess compatible adapter placement, existing protection and cable route. Enter zero only with documented confirmation that no additional materials are needed.

materialAssumptions.name: Floodlight electrical/mounting materials per floodlight
materialAssumptions.notes: Assess box, grounding, weather seal and any circuit work separately. Unknown materials and electrical labor/scope cannot be treated as included by a camera-only substitution.

financialAssumptions.notes: Offline scenarios only, not payroll or approved commissions. Supply a documented local sales-tax percentage; never default unknown tax/materials to zero. Tax applies to equipment plus separately purchased materials in this estimate. No owner labor or technician payroll is deducted. Shipping is a required cost input.

additionalMaterials.name: Compatible initial charging supply and cable extras per solar camera
additionalMaterials.notes: Verify SKU-included USB-C charging cable and a model-compatible charging supply before installation. Price missing supplies separately; documented zero requires verified included or available compatible supplies.

additionalMaterials.name: HomeBase placement, cabling and supply materials per installed hub
additionalMaterials.notes: Verify included hub adapter/Ethernet cable, safe power location and cable reach. Enter documented zero only when all required supplies are already included/available.

recommendationPolicy.notes: Legacy three-model selection and six package drafts remain unchanged. This homeowner path uses all six models, built-in/microSD/shared storage as appropriate, solar only after model-specific verification, and separate coverage positions even for rotating cameras. Prefer E40 for multiple suitable fixed locations in balanced mode; offer lower-cost S220 as an alternative. Budget mode compares known equipment costs only until materials are priced. Not a claim of market-wide cheapest procurement.

notes: Offline draft configurations only, not active offers or approved combinations. Location assignments are hypotheses, never site verification. Customer amounts resolve from unchanged baseline tiers; $599 is a starting price. Historical four-camera costs are an unverified comparison, not an approved budget. Null required costs make total materials and contribution incomplete. Labor, commissions, fees, tax, shipping, travel and overhead are not calculated.
